name: drama-ratings
title: Movie db
description: Search movie and TV ratings, metadata, and public share links
author: local

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Movies and TV
commands.description: Find ratings, metadata, and public cloud shares

preferences.name: doubanKey
preferences.title: ApiZero API Key (Optional)
preferences.description: API key for Douban ratings from ApiZero.

preferences.name: fallbackUrl
preferences.title: Douban Fallback API URL (Optional)
preferences.description: HTTPS URL containing {id}; JSON must return score or data.score.

preferences.name: tmdbKey
preferences.title: TMDB API Key or Read Access Token (Optional)
preferences.description: Get an API Key or Read Access Token from TMDB account settings.

preferences.name: telegramChannels
preferences.title: Telegram Search Channels
preferences.description: Comma-separated channel names, @usernames, or t.me links. Clear to restore defaults.
